title: Tapered grid: reference implementation, benchmark code, and raw measurement logs
description:
Research artifact for A Table-Free Index for Tapered Memoization Grids: Compact Out-of-Core Evaluation of Functions of Sorted Arguments.

A memoization table for functions of a sorted argument whose influence decays with rank. Its keys are the combinations with repetition, so the array index is the lexicographic rank in the combinatorial number system. This gives a table-free closed-form O(d) rank, an O(d) unrank (so keys need never be stored and the table can be built by any number of threads with zero coordination), and a values-only flat array that is memory-mappable and usable past the limits of RAM at one disk access per query.

Contains the reference implementation, the warped/selective ranker, the C++ benchmarks (in-RAM, out-of-core, Plackett-Luce, alpha-entmax), the dataset regeneration script, and the raw measurement logs for every experiment reported in the paper.

Follow-up to Biswas & Regan, Approximation of function evaluation over sequence arguments via specialized data structures, Theoretical Computer Science 607 (2015) 113-123.
